name: screensaver
title: Screensaver
description: A set of square images floats around a container, each travelling in a straight line and reversing at the edges, while centred text stays still behind the motion.
use: A 404 or empty page needs gentle ambient movement so it does not feel dead, without pulling focus from the message.
avoid: It never idles, so it can drain battery and distract on a long page, and it needs a sized overflow-hidden parent.
a11y: The nonstop motion never pauses or checks reduced-motion preferences, and it is purely decorative with no controls. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A near-black stage with a white 'page not found' headline at its centre. Around and behind it, about a dozen small square photos in mixed colours drift in a loose diagonal band, some clipped at the top edge.
behaves: Every photo moves at a steady speed along a straight diagonal and reverses when it reaches a container edge, so each one keeps bouncing. The headline stays fixed while photos pass behind it.
customise: Each instance takes its content as children plus speed, start angle, start position as percentages and the container ref; colours and image sources are whatever you pass in.
weight: moderate: Sixteen photos each update their position every frame through motion values.
demo: Eight Unsplash photos, doubled, behind the heading 'page not found'.
polishWhy: The bounce and layering work cleanly, but the effect is a stock idea with plain square photos.
